reviewContext: R5 whole-set visual meaning review: all 72 candidates inspected at 64 px and 24 px on light and dark grounds; revised duplicate and missing-feature candidates checked beside their closest lookalikes.

records.requiredFeatures: Open toothy grin; rounded eyes; no tears or blush.
Open toothy grin and visibly larger round eyes than other smiles.
Gentle upward-arc smiling eyes and an open toothy grin.
records.comparisonNotes: Compared beside 1f606, 1f60a and 1f600 at 64 px and 24 px on light/dark grounds: gentle upward-arc eyes and an open toothy grin distinguish it from a closed-mouth smile, squeezed eyes or round open eyes.

records.requiredFeatures: Tightly squeezed eyes and a broad open toothy grin.
records.comparisonNotes: Compared beside 1f604 and 1f600 at 64 px and 24 px on light/dark grounds: tight squeezed zigzag eyes and a broader open toothy grin are distinct from round eyes or gentle smiling arcs.

records.requiredFeatures: Recognizable grinning face with sweat silhouette with its defining subject and visible details.
Small restrained closed smile; neutral open eyes.
Both eyes closed in upward arcs, gentle smile and two blush marks.
records.comparisonNotes: Compared beside 1f604 and 1f970 at 64 px and 24 px on light/dark grounds: closed upward-arc eyes, blush and a closed gentle smile distinguish it from open teeth or floating hearts.

records.requiredFeatures: Recognizable smiling face with halo silhouette with its defining subject and visible details.
Normal smiling eyes, a gentle smiling mouth, blush and three small hearts floating around the head.
records.comparisonNotes: Compared beside 1f60d at 64 px and 24 px on light/dark grounds: eyes are normal smiling arcs with blush; three separate hearts float around the head, not in the eye sockets.

records.requiredFeatures: Two red heart-shaped eyes and a smiling mouth; hearts are the eyes, not floating around the head.
records.comparisonNotes: Compared beside 1f970 at 64 px and 24 px on light/dark grounds: two hearts occupy the eye positions; there are no floating hearts around the head.

records.comparisonNotes: Compared at 64 px and 24 px on light and dark grounds beside throwaway U+1F595 middle-finger and U+261D index-pointing-up references. This contour is one continuous rounded, slightly tapered and thicker side-mounted thumb lobe with no notch; both references retain long upright digits.
